title: qa(checklist): retire the objectui-pin wording left in the checklist ledger and the two QA skills (21 places in 14 items, plus checklist-test and dogfood-verification)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task** — in the 18.2.0 wave-2 session (2026-10-27), on the PM's list of improvements ("text still prescribing the retired objectui paths"), the maintainer answered, verbatim: 「还在写 objectui 旧路径的文字。立卡」.
Business reason: since the ui/ merge the Console is built in-repo (`pnpm console:build`); `.objectui-sha`, `pnpm objectui:build` and "objectui-repo-only" pins are gone. Wave-2 runners kept tripping on the old wording — e.g. `access-security.share-link-landing-page` still calls its pins "objectui-repo-only, not runnable from this checkout" while they run under `ui/apps/console/src/pages/`. A runner that follows the stale text skips runnable pins or builds the wrong thing.
Reader: the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`) for the ledger; the `domain:skills` seat for the two `.claude/skills/` files (Tier S). Revise each item (bump `revision`, append `history` citing this card); ⛔ never rewrite `history` rows — they record what was true then.
Dedupe (open AND closed): #26035 (closed) retired the same wording across 32 docs/AGENTS/skill files; this card is the remainder in the QA ledger and QA skills, measured at `main` ce9bc104 outside `history` rows.

## Where (measured on main, `history` rows excluded)

- `access-security.share-link-landing-page` ×6 · `platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface` ×3
- ×1 each: `ai.console-ai-surface-gating`, `approvals.request-page-reply-and-reader-visibility`, `attachments-storage.download-authz-both-sides`, `i18n.surface-matrix`, `records-forms.conditional-rules-grid`, `records-forms.import-wizard-encoding-and-hints`, `records-forms.gantt-interactions`, `records-forms.form-dirty-guard`, `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions`, `records-forms.field-group-visible-when`, `records-forms.v18-semantic-defaults`, `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu`
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` §4 environment fingerprint names `.objectui-sha` (the console build line replaces it).
- `.claude/skills/dogfood-verification/SKILL.md` the vendored-console section (around its "`.objectui-sha` 钉住" paragraph) still describes the pin and `packages/console/dist/.objectui-sha`.

Search pattern used: `objectui:build|objectui:refresh|\.objectui-sha|objectui-repo-only|objectui-only|objectui checkout|sibling objectui|objectui pin` (case-insensitive). A hit that names a historical objectui issue number or PR is not stale — keep it.

## Done when

- Zero hits of the pattern outside `history` rows in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` and the two skill files, each replaced by the in-repo form (`ui/...` paths, `pnpm console:build`, "the console build line").
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` and the skill line ratchet stay green.
